The player character: the person who drives a mech.

Mech system: equipment installed using System Points (SP).
Weapon mod: an upgrade attached to a mech weapon.
Mech or pilot weapon.
Two game senses: a weapon mount on a mech (noun), and the Mount action, climbing into a mech (verb). Never the UI sense.
Rules term: All PC mechs (and some NPCs) have a certain amount of STRUCTURE – generally 4 STRUCTURE for PCs.
Rules term: All PC mechs (and some NPCs) have a certain amount of STRESS – generally 4 STRESS for PCs.
Damage type and resource: heat builds toward overheating. Also the stat Heat Capacity.
The Overcharge action (spend heat for an extra quick action) and the overcharge cost track.
Mech skill (HASE): durability, HP and repair capacity.
Mech skill (HASE): evasion and speed.
Mech skill (HASE): electronic warfare, E-Defense and tech attack.
Mech skill (HASE): heat capacity and limited-system uses.
Rules term: A mech’s ARMOR reduces all incoming damage by that amount, excluding some special types of damage.
Rules term: EVASION is how hard it is for ranged and melee attacks to hit you.
Rules term: Your mech’s SPEED determines how far you can move on your turn, in spaces, when you make a standard move or BOOST.
Game stat: a character's footprint on the map (1/2, 1, 2, 3). The UI also uses "Size" for file size; that is a different key.
Rules term: Your mech’s SENSORS is the maximum distance (in spaces) over which a mech can detect enemies, use tech systems, and make tech attacks.
Rules term: Half of a character’s LL (rounded up), representing their experience in combat.
Game term: a saving throw (Hull save, Systems save). Not the UI button "Save" (store a file).
UI word: no selection or no value.
State of a pilot, core system or content pack. Adjective agreement differs by context; check the key.
UI word: waiting for an action or sync.
UI word: user-made content. Match the gender convention your locale uses.
Abbreviation of COMP/CON (brand). Keep in English.
Rules term: E-DEFENSE is how hard it is for electronic and guided weapons and systems to hit you.
Rules term: Your mech can take heat from tech attacks and some of its own systems.
Game stat.
Rules term: REPAIRS are a kind of currency that you can use to heal and repair your mech.
Game stat.
Rules term: You add your mech’s TECH ATTACK as a bonus instead of GRIT when you conduct electronic warfare
Damage type and status: ongoing damage at the end of each turn until a Systems save clears it. A noun, not the verb "to burn".
Damage type: physical impact.
Damage type: lasers, plasma and similar.
Damage type: blasts and shrapnel.
Activation type: Quick Action.
Activation type: Full Action. Not "full" as in no space left.
Activation type: Free Action (costs no action). Not "free" as in no charge.
Tag: This system can be activated as a free action, but only at the start of the user’s turn.
Tag: This system can be activated as a reaction.
Status or condition: All kinetic, explosive, or energy damage taken by this character is doubled.
Status or condition: Hostile characters can consume LOCK ON for +1 accuracy on their next attack against this character.
Status or condition: SHREDDED characters don’t benefit from ARMOR or RESISTANCE.
Status or condition: IMMOBILIZED characters cannot make any voluntary movements.
Status or condition: STUNNED mechs cannot OVERCHARGE, move, or take any actions.
Status or condition: JAMMED characters can’t use comms, make attacks other than IMPROVISED ATTACK, GRAPPLE, and RAM, take reactions, or take or benefit from tech actions.
Status or condition: This character can’t BOOST or make any special moves granted by talents, systems, or weapons.
Status or condition: IMPAIRED characters receive +1 difficulty on all attacks, saves, and skill checks.
Status or condition: Attacks against PRONE targets receive +1 accuracy. PRONE characters are SLOWED and count as moving in difficult terrain.
Status or condition: This character can’t be targeted by hostile attacks or actions, doesn't cause engagement, and enemies only know their approximate location.
Status or condition: All attacks against INVISIBLE characters have a 50 percent chance to miss before an attack roll is made. INVISIBLE characters can always HIDE, even without cover.
Status or condition: Ranged attacks made by an this character receive +1 difficulty. All additional movement is lost if ENGAGED by a target of equal or greater SIZE.
Status or condition: Heat level at half capacity or more.
Status or condition: While SHUT DOWN, mechs are STUNNED indefinitely.
Action: Brace your mech for impact, reducing damage at the cost of your next turn’s actions.
Terrain: soft or hard cover that gives Difficulty to attacks.
Bonus d6s on attacks and checks; the highest one is added. Cancels Difficulty one for one.
Penalty d6s on attacks and checks; the highest one is subtracted. Cancels Accuracy one for one.
Status or condition: Pilot is unconscious, any additional damage kills.
Rules term: Equipment with a BLAST attack pattern affects characters within a radius of X spaces, drawn from a point within RANGE and line of sight.
Rules term: Extra damage – kinetic, energy or explosive– that is added onto melee or ranged attacks.
Rules term: Equipment with a BURST attack pattern affects characters within a radius of X spaces, centered on and including the space occupied by the user (or target).
Rules term: A player character (PC), non-player character, (NPC), or any other entity capable of acting (or reacting) independently, such as DRONES.
Rules term: Equipment with a CONE attack pattern affects characters within a cone X spaces long and X spaces wide at its furthest point.
Rules term: A 20+ on a melee or ranged attack causes a critical hit.
Rules term: Damage taken is subtracted from HP, and is either kinetic, explosive, energy, or burn.
Rules term: When characters end their turn in dangerous terrain or move into it for the first time in a round, they must make an ENGINEERING check.
Rules term: All movement through difficult terrain is at half speed – each space of difficult terrain they move into is equivalent to two spaces of movement.
Rules term: The amount of damage a pilot can receive before going DOWN AND OUT, and the amount of damage a mech can receive before it takes structure damage.
Rules term: Characters with IMMUNITY ignore all damage and effects from whatever they are immune to.
Rules term: When characters are pushed, pulled, or knocked in certain directions, it is called involuntary movement.
Rules term: Equipment with a LINE attack pattern affects all targets within a straight line, X spaces long.
Range pattern and weapon stat: how far an attack reaches, in spaces.
Rules term: Characters with RESISTANCE reduce damage, heat, or a type of damage, by half, after ARMOR has been applied.
Rules term: When you force another character to make a save, they must match or beat your mech’s SAVE TARGET or take consequences.
Rules term: Mech FRAMES also have a set number of SYSTEM POINTS (SP).
Rules term: Characters must start and end a teleport on a surface they can normally move on; for example, a character that can’t fly can’t teleport mid-air.
Rules term: The maximum range at which melee and overwatch attacks can be made with certain weapons, measured from the attacking character.

Rules term: Mechs operating underwater, in zero-g, or in space are SLOWED unless they have a propulsion or flight system; however, they can’t fall and can fly when moving regardless of whether they have a flight system.
Rules term: Unless specified otherwise, characters start to fall at the end of the current turn, and fall at the end of each of their turns thereafter.
Rules term: Flying characters can move vertically and horizontally up to their SPEED.
Rules term: a flying character that stays in place without moving.
